lines.japanese: ──よし、お言葉をかえそう。馬鹿野郎とまで言われちゃな。
lines.english: —All right, then. I take it back. She'd gone so far as to call me an idiot, after all.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待てクレープ屋。てめ、バカヤロー言われた上で食べちゃったら、自分でバカヤローだって認めるようなもんじゃねえか、ブッ殺すぞバカヤロー」
lines.english: “Hold it, crêpe lady. If I eat your food after you call me an idiot, that's practically admitting I am one. I'll kill you, idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ～、ひとの好意を素直に受けとれないガキだねえ。いちいち突っぱらかってくンじゃないよ」
lines.english: “Honestly. What a child. Can't accept a kindness without bristling at every little thing.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、純粋な好意。それじゃあ今後、これを恩に着せて雑用に使うとか、そういうの無しって言えんの」
lines.english: “Oh, pure kindness? Then you can promise you won't hold this over me later and put me to work, right?”

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってやんでい。べつにこの件がどうこうじゃなくて、そりゃあ顔見知りとして多少の手を借りることくらいはあらァな」
lines.english: “Aw, what's this got to do with anything? We know each other. Course I might ask you for a little help now and then.”

lines.japanese: 「それだ。そんとき俺に拒否権が残されてるか否かに関わってくる。だいたいパルさんの言いつけはいつも“多少の手を借りる”ってレベルじゃねーんだよ」
lines.english: “There it is. Because when ‘now and then’ rolls around, the question is whether I’ll still be allowed to say no. And your little favors are never just ‘a little help.’”

lines.japanese: 「はン！　いつまでも、そんな細けェことこだわりゃーがって、このトンチキが。なら言ってみな、あたしがいつあんたに無理難題ふっかけたって言うんだい、エエッ」
lines.english: “Hah! Still nursing every petty little grievance, you nincompoop. Go on, then—when have I ever saddled you with an impossible demand? Eh?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ第三者に判定頼もうぜ。おー、なあ、新しく買った調理機材の配置がなかなか気に入ンなくて、クルマん中で上げたり下げたり何度も何度も死ぬほど何度も、ってどうなのコレ。コレ多少の手を借りるに入んの」
lines.english: “Let's ask an impartial third party. Hey, suppose somebody buys a new piece of kitchen equipment, can't decide where it goes, and makes you lift it up and put it down inside her van again and again and again—a million goddamn times. Does that count as ‘a little help’?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、まー、ドラさん男の子ですしー？」
lines.english: “Well... I mean, you're a boy, Dora...”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみにその機材ってアレな。アレ軽く４０～５０㎏ぐらいあんだけど」
lines.english: “For reference, the thing weighed a good forty or fifty kilos.”

lines.japanese: 「うはー、それはちょっと無理難題と呼んで差しつかえない部類かもしれませんねー」
lines.english: “Goodness. That may well fall within the class of tasks one could reasonably describe as an impossible demand.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい待っとくれよ。そんなね、たかが４０キロ程度でガタガタぬかす男がどこにいるってんだい。そんなもんおまえ、鳴坊ひとり抱きあげンのと大して変わんねえじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Now, hold on. What kind of man complains about a measly forty kilos? That's hardly any different from picking up little Naru here.”
“What?!”

lines.japanese: 「なに。え、なんでおまえ、ひとのことジロジロ見てんの。いや、持たない持たない。おまえなんか持ちあげたら、腕が粉砕骨折しちゃうって」
lines.english: “What? Why're you staring at me? No, I'm not picking you up. If I tried to lift you, both my arms would splinter.”

lines.japanese: 「はーん！　うら若き乙女に向かってなんて失礼な！」
lines.english: “Hmph! That's no way to speak to a delicate young lady!”

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ。だいたい、おまえいま、自分で５０キロを無理難題にカテゴライズしたんじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Why? You just classified fifty kilos as an impossible demand yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「ごごご５０キロもないです私ー！」
lines.english: “I-I-I do not weigh fifty kilos!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえは何キロでもいいけど、でも重量４０～５０キロつったら無理難題のうちなんだろ」
lines.english: “I don't care what you weigh. You said anything in the forty-to-fifty-kilo range counts as an impossible demand, right?”

lines.japanese: 「や、や、や、でもそれは年齢性別を考慮しない、あくまで一般論です。ドラさんの場合は健康的な成人男性なので、とくに無理でも難題でもありません」
lines.english: “W-w-well, yes, but that was only a general rule, without regard to age or sex. You're a healthy adult man, Dora, so for you it is neither impossible nor especially demanding.”

lines.japanese: 「ありませんじゃねーよ。勝手に判断すんじゃねーよ。いくらドラさんが健康的な成人男性でも、無理なもんは無理だろ。おまえ、どんだけ健康的な成人男性と縁のない暮らししてんだよ」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘it isn’t.’ You don’t get to decide that. Healthy adult man or not, if I can’t do it, I can’t do it. Have you never met a healthy adult man in your life?”

lines.japanese: 「かさねがさね無礼なこと言わないでください。男の子ならそれくらい、フンと鼻を鳴らして高々と持ちあげられるはずです。ささ、早く早く」
lines.english: “Please stop piling insult upon insult. Any boy ought to be able to give one proud snort and hoist that much right over his head. Go on, then. Hurry, hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「フン」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鼻を鳴らして、なぜか背中から向かってくる小さな体を横へ払った。
lines.english: I snorted and swept aside the little figure that had, for some reason, begun creeping up on me from behind.

lines.japanese: 「ああー」
lines.english: “Awww.”

lines.japanese: 「とにかくだ。世が世なら紙幣の一枚でも稼げるほどの労力と、腹の足しにもならねえ薄皮一枚とのトレードじゃ、こっちが割に合わねえだろ。悪りいけど遠慮しとくわ」
lines.english: “Anyway. In any decent world, that much labor would earn me a proper banknote. Trading it for one paper-thin skin that won’t even fill my stomach is a rotten deal. Sorry, but I’ll pass.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　冗談じゃねえや、まったくエエッ？　あたしだってね、あんたなんかに切り売りする親切はこれっぽっちも持ちあわせちゃいないってんだ。とっとと帰んなァ、この根性なし！」
lines.english: “Hah! Don't make me laugh! I haven't got one scrap of kindness to carve up and sell to the likes of you. Go on, get out of here, you spineless coward!”

lines.japanese: 「根性なしー」
lines.english: “Spineless coward.”

lines.japanese: 「あーい、そんじゃー」
lines.english: “Okaaay. See you.”

lines.japanese: 俺は右手をひらひらさせながら、クレープ屋に背中を向けた。
lines.english: I turned my back on the crêpe stand, fluttering one hand in farewell.

lines.japanese: 「鳴っ！　塩だ塩、塩まいときな！」
lines.english: “Naru! Salt! Get the salt and throw it after him!”

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth.*
